sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Filgotinib is not approved in the US by the Food and Drug Administration. No information is available on the clinical use of filgotinib during breastfeeding. The European manufacturer and an expert opinion recommend that breastfeeding be discontinued during filgotinib therapy.
Drug Levels and Effects > Drug Levels

Filgotinib is primarily metabolized to GS-829845, an active metabolite that has about 10% the activity of filgotinib.
